Delhi court criticizes police over murder case reclassification

A Delhi court has criticized the city's police for attempting to classify a case as an accident rather than a murder. The court reportedly found lapses in the police's investigation and handling of the case. This judicial reprimand highlights concerns about police procedures and accountability in serious criminal investigations.
